title: Exact Sharp Thresholds, Piecewise-Algebraic Squaring Laws, and Machine-Checked Thermodynamic Mass-Gap Certificates for the Reflection-Positive Purity Bootstrap
abstract: The reflection-positive purity bootstrap certifies a thermodynamic-limit spectral gap Delta_inf > 0 for interacting quantum lattice Hamiltonians from finite-size Euclidean partition-function purities, yet existing formulations rely on conservative defect cutoffs (u <= 0.01 in 1D and 1 - Q <= 1/(2a^2) in d spatial dimensions with a = 2^(d+1) - 1) and a flat gap ceiling Delta_inf > log(2)/beta_0. We derive the exact extremal laws and sharp stability boundaries of the purity bootstrap in arbitrary dimension d >= 1 and construct a machine-checked, zero-floating-point-trust certification pipeline. First, we solve the simplex squaring minimization problem inf{sum w_i^4 / (sum w_i^2)^2 : sum w_i = 1, sum w_i^2 = p} in closed piecewise-algebraic form on all of (0,1]; on (1/2,1] this coincides with h_1*(p) = 1 - (1-p)^2/(2p^2) via a three-line pure ring-algebra proof, accompanied by the uniquely attained spectral-gap ratio e^(beta Delta) >= (1 + sqrt(2p - 1))^2 / (2(1-p)). Second, using the exact staggered space-time plaquette identity in a cyclic Gauss-Seidel recurrence, we derive the exact algebraic uniform threshold 2 p^(2a) = (1-p)(sum_{j=0}^{a-1} p^j)^2, widening the 1D uniform basin by 12.73x (u_c*(1) = 0.127311) and enlarging the single-Q threshold by 3.26x to 7.63x for d = 1..5 (asymptotically 8x, scaling as 4/(a(a+1))). Third, we prove an exact doubly-exponential contraction bound yielding Delta_inf >= (1/(2^N beta_0)) log(1/(K_d(u_N) u_N)) for all intervening even hypercube lengths l >= L_0, breaking the log(2)/beta_0 ceiling. All 16 core algebraic theorems and lemmas are formalized in zero-dependency Lean 4 (v4.35.0, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice), paired with a zero-float-trust exact-Q verifier (including rational logarithm mass-gap bounds) benchmarked on the 1D TFIM (2.24x-4.72x closer to h_c=1, up to 9.03x tighter gaps), ferromagnetic g=2 Kramers-Wannier sector duality, 2D (D=3) lattices, and synthetic noisy intervals. On interacting spin chains, we prove an su(3) determinant obstruction showing that the Spin-1 AKLT chain violates bond-reflection positivity for every U in U(3), and certify exact-Q thermodynamic gaps on two provably bond-RP non-integrable chains—Spin-1 Heisenberg with single-ion anisotropy (L_0=4->8) and Spin-1/2 dimerized Heisenberg (L_0=6->12)—where Grover's u <= 0.01 fails at every tested parameter.
